nav.title: Setsi sa puisano ya AI
nav.subtitle: Thuso ya dipuo tse dintsi le phetisetso e laolwang go motho.

status.configured: Mokgwa o o babaletsweng o tlhophilwe
status.apiUnavailable: Go tsena / API ga e yo

stats.uniqueCodes: Dikhoutu tsa dipuo tse di farologaneng
stats.providerQualification: Go nna le bokgoni ga motlamedi
stats.providerQualificationNote: Dipuo tse di tlhatlhilweng fela di balwa

customer.title: Simolola puisano
customer.consentText: Ke dumela gore puisano eno e ka dirwa ke motlamedi wa AI. Dikwalo di khutsufadiwa pele di bolokwa.
customer.startChat: Simolola puisano ya sekwalwa e e babalesegileng
customer.setupHint: Ga e yo go fitlha molaodi a tlhoma senotlolo le motlamedi wa AI.
customer.noConversation: Ga go na puisano e e dirang
customer.startHint: Dira puisano ka tumelano go simolola.
customer.chatEmpty: Molaetsa o a bonala fano. Ditiro tsa AI ke dikatso fela; ga go na tefo kgotsa phetolo ya akhaonto.
customer.voiceStreamNote: Lentswe la browser le romelwa kwa motlameding; OpsCore ga e bue gore e boloka lentswe la nnete.
customer.voiceRequirement: Lentswe la browser le tlhoka HTTPS, maekorofono, tumelano, mofuta wa Realtime le senotlolo. Ga se mogala.

queue.title: Kelotlhoko ya phetisetso
queue.description: Dipuisano tse di kotsi kgotsa tse di kopileng motho di a bonala fano. Kelotlhoko ke kopo, ga se kgokagano.
queue.empty: Ga go na phetisetso mo setlhopheng seno.
queue.replyStorageNote: Dikarabo tsa batho di bolokilwe di khutsufaditswe mme di a bonala mo puisanong.
queue.resolveNote: E feditswe ke modiri yo o abetsweng.

boundaries.title: Melelwane ya ditiro
boundaries.automateBody: Karabo ya ntlha ka dipuo tse dintsi, tlhaloso, tekolo ya kotsi, go boloka dikwalo le go aga kelotlhoko.
boundaries.humanTitle: Phetisetso kwa mothong e a tlhokega
boundaries.humanBody: Kopo ya motho, go sa tshepe, kotsi e kgolo, melao e e tshwerweng, kgetse e e sa rarabololwang, ngongoregiso ya sephiri.
boundaries.notEnabledTitle: Ga e a kgonwa ke setlhopha seno fela
boundaries.notEnabledBody: PSTN/SIP, WhatsApp, imeile, mogala, CRM le netefatso ya puo di tlhoka motlamedi wa nnete le diteko.

handoffReasons.voice_review_required: Tlhatlhobo ya lentswe e a tlhokega

messages.qualificationNotice: Ga go na puo e e netefaditsweng go fitlha diteko tsa sekwalwa, ASR, TTS le lentswe di feta.
messages.configNeeded: Peakanyo e sa ntse e tlhokega: {missing}.
messages.configOk: Peakanyo e teng. Kgokagano le boleng jwa puo di tlhoka diteko tsa nnete.
messages.conversationCreated: Puisano e e babalesegileng e dirilwe. Boleng jwa puo ga bo a netefadiwa.
messages.handoffQueued: Phetisetso kwa mothong e beilwe mo kelotlhokong ({reason}). Ke kopo, ga se kgokagano.
messages.aiResponseFailed: Karabo ya AI ga e a felela. Ga go na tiro e e dirilweng. O ka kopa motho.
messages.apiUnavailable: API ya setsi ga e a bonwa. Tsena mo OpsCore, morago o ntšhafatse tsebe eno.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: Phetisetso e beilwe mo kelotlhokong ({reason}). Kelotlhoko ga e bontshe gore modiri o teng.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: Phetisetso e beilwe mo kelotlhokong. Puisano ya AI e a ema; mogala ga o a tlhomiwa.
messages.voiceCredentialRequest: Go kopa senotlolo sa lentswe sa nakwana…
messages.voiceRealtimeError: Motlamedi wa Realtime o bontshitse phoso. Emisa lentswe, sekaseka peakanyo, o leke gape.
messages.voiceActive: Puisano ya lentswe e a dira. Kopa motho nako nngwe le nngwe; se dirile kelotlhoko, ga se mogala.

errors.CONTACT_CENTER_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Tumelano e a tlhokega pele puisano e simolola.
errors.SERVER_RESPONSE_INVALID: Karabo ya server ga e a balega.
errors.CONTACT_CENTER_REALTIME_CONNECT_FAILED: Motlamedi wa lentswe wa Realtime ga o a bonwa.
errors.BROWSER_REALTIME_VOICE_UNSUPPORTED: Browser eno ga e tshegetse lentswe la Realtime.
